mechanism: Echinacea may cause sodium retention and increase blood pressure, potentially opposing the antihypertensive effects of chlorthalidone; additionally, echinacea may have immunostimulatory effects that could theoretically interfere with thiazide-related metabolic effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly during concurrent use; counsel patient on potential reduced efficacy of chlorthalidone and consider alternative herbal products with fewer cardiovascular interactions.
